UI.INV_DESC_FISHING_KIT: A large rag sack, paired with markers leading to waters abundant with aquatic bugs.

Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_MEET: <page>Spider... So hungry... Will you serve yourself to me..?<hpage>No, I will not offer myself as food, sir. Should you wish to attempt anyway, I am prepared to defend myself.<page>Disappointing... So hungry... You do not wish to serve yourself to me... Will you bring me food..?<page>The aquatic bugs of this land... So tasty...<hpage>I would consider seeking food for you. However, I expect to be compensated for such trivial a task.<page>Of course... Of course... Compensated... Many rosaries to spare...<page>Take this... Seek the waters at these locations... Bring your catch to me... So hungry...
Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_MEET_CORPSE: <page>Spider... Do not disturb my meal...<page>Unless... You wish to serve yourself to me... As this bug has...<hpage>I will not offer myself as food, sir. I merely seek this bug's relic. I will leave you to your meal.<page>Disappointing... So hungry... You do not wish to serve yourself to me... Will you bring me food..?<page>The aquatic bugs of this land... So tasty...<hpage>I would consider seeking food for you. However, I expect to be compensated for such trivial a task.<page>Of course... Of course... Compensated... Many rosaries to spare...<page>Take this... Seek the waters at these locations... Bring your catch to me... So hungry...
Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_TAKE_KIT: <page>Take the kit... Seek the waters... Bring your catch to me... <page>So hungry...
Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_ASK_FEED: <page>Aquatic bugs... I smell them on you... Offer them to me... Quick... So hungry...
Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_WAS_FED: <page>Mmm... So delicious... Go, bring more... Still hungry...
Hungry Craw.HUNGRY_CRAW_WAS_FED_HAS_MORE: <page>Mmm... So delicious... I smell more... Yes, give more... More...

Fishes.DESC_ZOTEFISH: Originating from a mysterious land, this creature resembles a terrifying knight of great renown.
Fishes.DESC_KAI: Plump, plentiful drifter of a coral past.
Fishes.DESC_STEELSPINE_KAI: Toughened Kai capable of extending sharp spikes from within its shellsack.
Fishes.DESC_FLEAFISH: Amphibious cousin of the Flea found in pools near large gatherings of its companions.
Fishes.DESC_SLUBBERLUG: Younger form of a Muckroach. Attacks prey by leaping from the water and snapping with its flexible jaws.
Fishes.DESC_ARCHERFISH: Tiny predator that hunts terrestrial bugs by shooting powerful streams from its mouth, knocking its prey into the water.
Fishes.DESC_VOLTAIC_EEL: Elusive worm-like creature with an elastic Voltridian underside. Discharges powerful shocks to paralyse its prey.
Fishes.DESC_ECHO: Formless shade of a life long past. A fragment of its lingering will remains suspended within the void.
Fishes.DESC_CRINOLIA: Swimming plant-like life stage of a large colonial organism beneath Shellwood Pond.
Fishes.DESC_HARPFIN: Creature with large fins adapted for both swimming and producing sounds to ward off predators.
Fishes.DESC_LYMDRA: Predatory nymph of a flying insect said to have grown enormous in a long-lost land.
Fishes.DESC_DREGREAPER: Crafty creature that spins Silk dregs into nets to catch food and rear its young.
Fishes.DESC_SPLINTMARE: Aquatic Splinter equipped with a sharp proboscis for sucking nutrients out of underwater roots.
Fishes.DESC_CLARIOPOD: Soft mollusc protected by a curved shell made from minerals sucked off the Citadel's gilded surfaces.
Fishes.DESC_COGLICHEN: Rich colony of algae and fungi packed within the shell of an old automaton.
Fishes.DESC_VOIDPOLE: Transient coalescence of void around remnants of soul, which swirl inside as organs.
Fishes.DESC_MUCKMAGGOT: Mindless infant larva, coated in a thick slime. Farmed for food throughout the moors.
Fishes.DESC_CRYSTACEAN: Bottom feeder with a coldshard shell that regenerates upon moulting, and even after death.
Fishes.DESC_PLASMYOND: Drifting cocoon filled with strange liquid, which its tentacles inject into anything that approaches.
Fishes.DESC_CRUSTERISK: Spiny hunter that reproduces by shedding limbs, which feed on coral crust until they grow into new Crusterisk.
Fishes.DESC_CANDLEMAW: Fanged, swimming worm that lures prey with a mucus-coated Wisp at the tip of its long tongue.
Fishes.DESC_SHILLFIN: Large swimmer of a forgotten coral dynasty. Deals devastating blows by ramming with its steel mask.
Fishes.DESC_DRIZNUR: Timid scuttler that burrowed into a discarded Driznarga shell for protection.
Fishes.DESC_FAYFISH: Aquatic offshoot of a mythical feathered bug. Encountering this remarkable creature is said to spell good fortune.
Fishes.DESC_ETHEREAIL: Carnivorous slug once abundant in the clear waters of the east. Adept at culling the numbers of Muckmaggots.
Fishes.DESC_FOBOBOS: Blubbery grub with rigid wings adapted for swimming. Curious and docile when well fed.
Fishes.DESC_ROSARY_OYSTER: Ornate armoured mollusc farmed in the Citadel for its ability to coat rosaries within its shell.
Fishes.DESC_SHADE_SNARE: Large concentration of darkness with a tendril proboscis designed for trapping and shredding.
Fishes.DESC_CORRCRUST_OUTCROP: Colony of a unique coral capable of ejecting burning bubbles from its inner cavities.
Fishes.DESC_REED_MIMIC: Stealthy predator with retractable appendages stemming from its jaw. Preys on any surface-dweller foolish enough to make contact.
Fishes.DESC_TROBBIO_FISH: Flamboyant plumed swimmer with large wing-like fins that propel it through the water with elegance and style.
Fishes.DESC_EVERBLOOM_FISH: Fleeting lifeform that emits a rare light to resist overwhelming darkness. Its origin is unknown.
Fishes.DESC_BLOBATHAN: Gelatinous gob of bile discharge, turned sentient and imbued with an insatiable hunger.
Fishes.DESC_BLOATLING: Bottom-feeding relative of the flying Bloatroach. Feeds on sludge in bile pools until adulthood.
Fishes.DESC_GROAL_FROG: Heavy amphibious hopper armed with globs of sizzling bile stored in a sack on its neck.
Fishes.DESC_SERVITOR_HERMIT: Large, lanky creature kept warm by the silklight generator of a faulty Servitor Boran.
Fishes.DESC_GLOOM_RAY: Scaly mass with a porous underside for filtering what little nutrients can be found in the sea of void.
Fishes.DESC_MNEMOGIN: Thin bug with coldshard spikes suspended around its back.
Fishes.DESC_POLLIP_SNAKE: Twisted serpent that secretes a thick toxin from its skin, which it can reabsorb to rejuvenate itself.
Fishes.DESC_SUMPSUCKER: Small suction creature that feeds upon accumulated sludge, maintaining the Pale Lake's pure shine.
Fishes.DESC_MOORFIN: Tiny aquatic bug with poor eyesight. Aimlessly leaps from the water at the first sign of danger.
Fishes.DESC_SNAIL: Docile yet powerful invertebrate, the youngest member of a caste of ancient sorcerers.
Fishes.DESC_TRAPJAW: Deadly predator with a powerful bite, yet its razor-sharp teeth are often harvested for constructing pest traps.
Fishes.DESC_BELL_SLUG: Small winged grub hidden in a discarded bell to compensate for its soft exterior.
Fishes.DESC_BOB: Gentle surface floater equipped with a dense coat on its underside to shield it from frigid waters.
Fishes.DESC_MAGNETITE_COMPOUND: Colonial organism with a vibrating magnetite shell that filters minerals from the surrounding water.
Fishes.DESC_CYMBAL_FISH: Drifts just beneath the water surface, grazing on floating particles and algae overhead.
Fishes.DESC_PHACIA_OCTOPUS: Flexible hunter that curls into a flower bud, lying in wait for unwary prey.
Fishes.DESC_BUH: Foul creature that thrives in the filth of Bilewater. Its slick shell protects it from the poisons that would doom others.
Fishes.DESC_FIH: Strange swimmer found drifting through the Pale Lake, trailing a mass of slender limbs.
Fishes.DESC_BAMBOO_SPIDER: Stealthy inhabitant of a once vast thicket, now left to wander the lower moors.
Fishes.DESC_PETRIFIED_SKIPPER: Corpse of a Pond Skipper reanimated by a twisting parasitic root.
Fishes.DESC_WATER_MUSHROOM: A wandering spore, born of a greater fungal colony and driven to spread across distant lands.
Fishes.DESC_SHADOW_AMMONITE: Crawls along the bed of the void, periodically surfacing to feed or mate.
Fishes.DESC_MOSSBACK: Clever creature that feeds on the moss and algae gathered upon the buoyant protrusion on its back.
Fishes.DESC_GLISTENING_BARNACLES: Colony of sedentary creatures abundant in the eastern bay, bleached and purified by pale water.
Fishes.DESC_ABYSSAL_LANTERN: Entices others with its bioluminescent antennae and maw before swallowing them whole.
Fishes.DESC_GROMSPAWN: Detached Grom broodsack filled with unborn larvae stirring within.
Fishes.DESC_PALE_CARP: Unusual Wyrm with a blinding divine glow. For this prescient being, death merely marks a transformation.
Fishes.DESC_GRAVE_CRAB: Tall crawler with eyes on all sides, granting an unparalleled awareness of its surroundings.
